fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-29, the complainant paid an advance of Rs. 25,000 for a tour package, but the service was not provided and the payee stopped responding. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-27 at roughly 16:55. Yogesh Arumugam reported the matter orally at Erode North PS; the contact number given was 9000000029. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100051. A witness, Ganesh Shankar, reachable on 9000000155, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint refers to Prakash Muthu, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000312. A person named Venkat Palanisamy, associated with the number 9000000134, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Advance allegedly collected for a service that was not provided.
